ImageDescription.value: Recording of the production : Die Macht des Schicksals by Giuseppe Verdi (The Force of Destiny, 1961). Austrian actress and soprano Helga Dernesch wearing a stage costume with a crown and veil. She is renowned for her major performances in the operas of Richard Wagner and Richard Strauss. Her career has spanned from dramatic soprano to mezzo-soprano, performing on the world's greatest stages.
